title: IndianBailJudgments-1200: A Multi-Attribute Legal NLP Dataset for Bail Order Understanding in India

bias_targets.methodology: Annotating real-world legal judgments with the accused's gender and a boolean 'bias_flag' using an LLM-based extraction pipeline (GPT-4o) and expert verification, enabling downstream correlation studies between gender and bail outcomes.
Extracting a boolean 'bias_flag' from unstructured court judgments via an LLM annotation pipeline to explicitly identify and flag cases where caste-based judicial bias is potentially present.
Extracting a boolean 'bias_flag' from court judgments via an LLM annotation pipeline to capture and flag broader identity-based biases in legal reasoning and bail decisions.
